highlights: Roll over: move a pair into the next maturity from Positions, as one all-or-nothing batch
The banner says which pairs are ready to roll and which later maturity pays more
The venue previews the roll: a leg that cannot fill whole, or margin that runs short, blocks the hold
Can it fund? shows what the new legs need against what is spendable before and after
Every trade form shares one look: the same market picker, size box and Estimate card
A Boros order that fails names the leg and the reason; hide inactive pairs is on by default
